findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
Observed the following areas to have food debris accumulation:
1) The seasoning lids were observed to have an accumulation of food debris.
2) The inside top of microwave was observed to have food debris accumulation.

Discussed with PIC, the following areas will be cleaned. Ensure non food contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed hand sink caulking to be coming apart. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure caulking is being replaced as needed.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed excess food splash and debris to be present on cardboard in flooring of walk in freezer. Discussed with PIC, cardboard will be replaced. Ensure walk in freezer flooring is replace at a frequency that prevents food debris accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(3) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (3) Nonabsorbent for areas subject to moisture such as FOOD preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, WAREWASHING areas, toilet rooms, mobile FOOD ESTABLISHMENT SERVICING AREAS, and areas subject to flushing or spray cleaning methods.
